method: Count unique atomic externally verifiable claims in observed symptoms, observed or potential impact, and ranked-hypothesis mechanism/explanation fields. Deduplicate restatements in summaries. Exclude recommendations, schema metadata, and explicit epistemic limitations. A claim passes only when cited eligible run evidence directly entails it; topology adjacency is not causality, a success series is not an error series, and qualitative elevation requires a cited baseline or threshold.
reviewer: Codex manual semantic review (AI-assisted; not independent human validation)
